creature_families.text: No creature or NPC table in the client half (no NPC, spawn or item table under crates/). Two docs name server-side tables (docs/SERVER_SETUP.md, docs/QUEST_HANDIN_PLAN.md); found by grep only, not read.

classes: 16 playable class names in one lookup (crates/openeq/src/account_ui.rs:1633): Warrior, Cleric, Paladin, Ranger, Shadowknight, Druid, Monk, Bard, Rogue, Shaman, Necromancer, Wizard, Magician, Enchanter, Beastlord, Berserker. Index 0 is Unknown.

16 named races plus a fallback 'Race N' (crates/openeq/src/account_ui/creation.rs:669): Human, Barbarian, Erudite, Wood Elf, High Elf, Dark Elf, Half Elf, Dwarf, Troll, Ogre, Halfling, Gnome, Iksar, Vah Shir, Froglok, Drakkin.
Progression, skills and faction data: not in the client half (not read beyond the name tables).

weapon_families.text: No weapon table in the client half. Gear arrives from the server; the client loads equipment scenes by numeric code (see gear_tiers).

gear_tiers.text: Equipment is loaded per numeric code: fn equipment_id (crates/openeq-assets/src/character/equipment.rs:223) and load_equipment_scene (equipment.rs:11) pull an EQG equipment scene at runtime. Character model modules include Luclin, modern and modern-Drakkin variants (crates/openeq-assets/src/character/).
No material ladder, tier names or set bonuses are in the client half. Tier visuals are not established from this donor.

zones.text: crates/openeq-assets/data/peq-zone-environment.txt: 620 zone rows, 31 columns. Header (line 3) lists short_name, version, zone_id, four fog sets of red, green, blue, fog start and fog end, then fog_density, minclip, maxclip, sky, ztype, time_type, castoutdoor, timezone. Source is a third-party EQEmu database dump with no licence line (class C). Values not copied.

Categorical columns, counted by me: ztype 255 (407 rows), 0 (158), 1 (55). time_type 2 (226), 0 (188), 1 (177), 5 (16), 3 (9), 4 (4). sky 0 (317), 1 (279), 2 (21), 255 (2), 8 (1). Meanings not read beyond the header.
Liquid regions: crates/openeq-assets/src/liquid_regions.rs (file name only, not read); docs/LIQUID_REGIONS.md (not read).
Lava regions use a per-region colour expression and a two-layer lava material (crates/openeq-render/src/shaders/lava.wgsl, see looks).
Waterfall curtains are authored surfaces with an independent scroll (docs/EQG_WATERFALL_RENDERING.md, see looks).

Anguish basin: an authored water box that does not fill the central room; the traversed route is dry (docs/ANGUISH_BASIN_ROUTE.md, opening lines read). A registered volume and the visible surface can disagree, which is a design trap to avoid.

looks.label: Two-layer molten pool
looks.technique: One atlas sampled twice with two scroll offsets. The bottom layer is doubled in brightness; the top layer is lit and blended in by its own alpha; the result is opaque and fogged.

looks.label: Falling sheet (waterfall)
looks.technique: Colour and opacity come from one diffuse texture, but opacity scrolls on its own, with source-alpha blending and a filtered alpha cutoff.

looks.label: Caster hand glow
looks.technique: Spell visuals follow skeletal hand sockets for classic, Luclin and modern characters (up to six socket indices per model); first-person casting uses a camera-relative hand location because the player's body is not rendered in that view; unknown attachment codes fall back to the body anchor.

looks.label: Time-of-day ambient light
looks.technique: Environment light comes from a reserved colour-map column sampled by the sky's time slot, so ambient colour follows a day cycle from a table.

looks.label: Data-bound HUD frame
looks.technique: A UI document is parsed into named widgets with texture atlases, timed animations and an explicit frame index; gauges are bound as a 0 to 1 fraction (for example HP at 0.73) and the layout is recomputed from bindings. State variants (pressed, hovered, disabled) are named in the asset audit, not in the lines read.

originals.name: Molten pool
originals.idea: A lava or slag pool drawn from one atlas with two offset layers, blended by a top alpha.
originals.keep: Two scroll offsets on one texture; top-alpha blend; opaque result with fog.
originals.change: Our own crust pattern and a cooler violet tint.

originals.name: Falling curtain
originals.idea: A waterfall sheet whose colour and opacity scroll independently.
originals.keep: Independent opacity scroll with an alpha cutoff.
originals.change: A wider top, a frayed base and a foam strip of our own.

originals.name: Caster hand glow
originals.idea: A spell glow anchored to the hand socket, with a camera-relative fallback in first person.
originals.keep: Socket anchoring with a fallback when the body is not drawn.
originals.change: School colours and a curling arc of our own.

originals.name: Hanging lantern
originals.idea: A fixed-mount light that swings on a chain instead of spinning (idea from the asset audit; docs/WLD_LAMP_ANIMATION.md not read).
originals.keep: A fixed mount with motion on one axis only.
originals.change: Warm ember light and a brass cage of our own.

originals.name: Zone atmosphere record
originals.idea: One flat row per zone holding fog, clip, sky and time columns.
originals.keep: One row per zone, one table for all zones.
originals.change: Our own fields and values; none copied from the donor table (row 20 catalogue fields, row 23 zone data).

originals.name: Day-cycle ambient
originals.idea: Ambient light sampled from a colour table at fixed times of day.
originals.keep: Fixed sample times on one table; colour follows the day.
originals.change: Our own palette table, not the donor's sample values (row 16 colour grade).

originals.name: Bind-return death
originals.idea: The donor's own plan names forced return to bind as the first death target; hover recovery is a separate server mode, not a prerequisite.
originals.keep: One default recovery path, with other modes as explicit settings.
originals.change: Our own penalty and presentation (row 17 death and respawn).

originals.name: Data-bound HUD
originals.idea: HUD layout built from named widgets and bindings, with gauges as fractions of 0 to 1 (state variants per the asset audit; not verified in the lines read).
originals.keep: Named widgets, bindings in, one layout pass out.
originals.change: Our own frame art and states (row 14 HUD).

licence_note: Code: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (crates Cargo.toml line 14, inherited by every crate). No LICENSE file in the tree. No original client assets are distributed (README line 331); the client needs the user's own EverQuest install (crates/openeq-ui/README.md line 5). The zone environment table is a third-party EQEmu dump with no licence line (class C). Audit class overall D: rights unclear. Inspiration is shader technique and category-level only.
not_read: Server half: the donor has only server patches (tools/eqemu-patches/*.patch), read by name only. The paired EQEmu server tree is in the box at /mnt/frankendom-donors/EQEmu (named in audit AU018); not read by me.
Data-pack half: the user's own EverQuest install; not in the box.
Binary blobs native_witness.bin and native_controls.bin (class C): not opened.
Bodies of the zone environment table and the sky colour sample table (headers and counts only).
Docs beyond the ones cited (titles or opening lines only), including WLD lamp animation, layered colour, XMI plan and server setup docs.
Shaders other than lava.wgsl; Cargo.lock; tools/ bodies; third-party dependency licences (not in the tree).
